acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce under induced load or prove the race (host, Go version, run count, ordering observed).
Fix the witness ordering, or bound it with a disclosed limit; the interruption assertion is not weakened.
body: `GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -timeout 30m ./cmd/corvint/ -run TestHostAdapter` failed once on 2026-10-04 (Go 1.27.1, darwin/arm64) at host_adapter_javascript_test.go:92: "harness ended before descendant witness: <nil>", in the V1-0773 worktree whose change touches only the OpenCode plugin and JS tests. Three isolated reruns of `-run TestHostAdapterJavaScriptHarnessInterruption` passed (two on the change, one at base 3e72363c). Suspected load-dependent race; not confirmed or reproduced on demand.

completion.reason: PR beamfall/corvint#591 merged into main as 3c3b5c39fb1180534ae8fec9f9f81e64228ae179 (2026-10-05T04:13:20Z). Cause: the hang-mode fixture published the child PID with os.WriteFile, so the JS interruption test could copy an empty PID (read as 0) while the inner harness finished on the 4 s query timer. AC1 met by proof of the race: on Go 1.27.1 darwin/arm64, a scratch 300 ms gap between create and write failed 3 of 3 with the original message; natural-load reproduction was not obtained, so this is the demonstrated cause, not a unique attribution. AC2 met: the fixture now publishes with tmp+rename (passing 3 of 3 under the same widened gap and 10 of 10 focused), the interruption assertion and witness deadline are unchanged, and the failure message adds exit= to separate other causes. Codex review found two build-log errors, both fixed; dogfood check and seal PASS. Limits: make gate NOT_RUN; corvint affected scope UNKNOWN. Evidence: sha256 at 3c3b5c39 of the build log, the fixture and the JS harness test. Completed by the orchestrator at the request of the authoring session.
